# NewPharma — ¿Qué es NewPharma?

Canonical production page: https://www.newpharma.cl/pages/que-es-new-pharma
Store: https://www.newpharma.cl/
Language: Spanish (Chile)

## Brand summary

NewPharma presents itself as a Chilean wellness brand founded in Viña del Mar in 2020. Its published About page emphasizes integral wellbeing, product research and selection, quality, innovation, sustainability, ethical choices and local production.

## Facts communicated on the published page

- Origin: Viña del Mar, Chile.
- Starting year: 2020.
- Participation in the Programa de Uso de Marca Chile.
- Participation for a second consecutive year in the Catálogo de Innovación Alimentaria de Chile 2023.
- Vegan and gluten-free options; applicability should be checked product by product.
- Participation communicated in Todos Reciclamos.
- Commitment to local production and community economic development.

## Main page sections

1. Wellbeing from nature.
2. Brand mission.
3. Timeline: 2020, 2022–2023 and today.
4. Quality, innovation and sustainability.
5. Educational criteria for evaluating functional mushroom products.
6. Local origin and production.
7. Verified customer reviews through Judge.me.
8. Frequently asked questions.
9. Links to products, benefits and stores.

## Accuracy note

Technical product claims, certifications and review quotes must be connected to product-specific and verifiable evidence before the Shopify page is published.
